<script>
    let bannerWrapper = document.querySelector('#bottom-anchor-ad-wrapper');
    window.addEventListener('Inpl.scroll_branding.loaded', function(ev) {
        if( ev.detail && ev.detail.slot ) {
            bannerWrapper.style.display = 'block';
        }
    });
    document.querySelector('.bottom-anchor__close').addEventListener('click', e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        bannerWrapper.style.display = 'none';
        if (window.iwa3) {
            window.iwa3("send", "event", "scroll_branding", "zamknij", "klik", "desktop");
        }
    });

    // toggle point (max 1800px)
    const togglePoint = Math.min(Math.max(document.body.scrollHeight, document.documentElement.scrollHeight), 1800);
    const createDebouncedHandler = function(delay, callback) {
        let timer = null;
        return function (...args) {
            if (timer !== null) {
                clearTimeout(timer);
            }
            timer = setTimeout(() => {
                timer = null;
                callback.apply(this, args);
            }, delay);
        };
    };

    const handleScroll = () => {
        const scrollPosition = Math.max(window.pageYOffset, document.documentElement.scrollTop, document.body.scrollTop)
        if (!bannerWrapper.style.transition) {
            bannerWrapper.style.transition = "opacity 0.6s ease";
        }

        const isAboveTogglePoint = scrollPosition < togglePoint;
        bannerWrapper.style.opacity = isAboveTogglePoint ? "1" : "0";
        bannerWrapper.style.pointerEvents = isAboveTogglePoint ? "auto" : "none";
    };

    window.addEventListener('scroll', createDebouncedHandler(150, () => {
        bannerWrapper && window.requestAnimationFrame(handleScroll);
    }));
</script>
